what: The documentation sidebar repeats the overview and hides common sections; the docs brand lacks the landing logo.
expected: One overview link, persistent common links, expandable section sublinks, and the landing RELKIT mark.
observed: At /docs, both Documentation and RELKIT documentation link to /docs; the tutorial shows only Learn links, and the header has no logo.
root_cause: apps/docs/blume.config.ts used navigation.tabs, which scopes Blume's sidebar to the current section. The generated tree linked folder index pages through both group headings and child rows. The configuration omitted logo.
fixed_by: Use the existing catalogs to build one explicit nested Blume sidebar, linking each overview only from its group heading. Configure persistent Home, Documentation and GitHub links, and reuse /logo.svg.
reproduction: Open /docs at 1920x1080 and inspect the two links to /docs.
Open /docs/learn/create-an-app and inspect the missing common sections and text-only header.

before.note: New navigation test fails against the original production build.

after.note: 23 cases passed on port 3001; the remaining test hard-codes port 3002.
The remaining landing navigation case passes on its required port 3002.

browser.assertion: The overview appears once and is marked current. Common links and nested sections remain available on all five tested routes; current-page highlighting and the landing logo render. The mobile menu supports keyboard expansion and sublink navigation without horizontal overflow. All 24 browser cases passed across the preview run and the targeted standard-port rerun.
steps: Open /docs and /docs/learn/create-an-app at 1920x1080 and assert unique destinations, current page and logo.
Open the tutorial at 390x844, show the mobile drawer and assert no duplicate links or overflow.
Run all 24 existing and new browser cases against the current production build on port 3001.
Rerun the single landing navigation case on its hard-coded port 3002.
